sources.license: Facts summarized from a public GitHub issue/PR; short error excerpt quoted.

symptom: Startup fails with NoSuchBeanDefinitionException: No qualifying bean of type OAuth2ClientProperties when a user-defined ClientRegistrationRepository bean takes OAuth2ClientProperties as a parameter, even though spring.security.oauth2.client.registration.* is configured.
cause: OAuth2ClientConfigurations.ClientRegistrationRepositoryConfiguration carries a class-level @ConditionalOnMissingBean(ClientRegistrationRepository). When the application defines its own repository the whole class is skipped, including its @EnableConfigurationProperties(OAuth2ClientProperties.class), so the properties bean is never registered.
fixSummary: Register the properties yourself: add @EnableConfigurationProperties(OAuth2ClientProperties::class) to your own configuration class (@ConfigurationPropertiesScan or binding the spring.security.oauth2.client prefix with Binder also works), and keep reading the values from the configuration. Fixed in Boot 4.0.9.
